question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: Resulticks is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
beats.action: A halftone paper document drops onto a cream chip and settles flat.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The document folds into a stack of paper coins; a cutout screen rises behind it and holds.

beats.line: Diginex moves from a point solution to an integrated platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the screen splits into two paper tiles; tape binds them into one panel.

beats.line: Now two workflows: sustainability compliance, and customer intelligence.
beats.headline: 2 WORKFLOWS
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the bound panel opens into a paper ledger on the left and a screen on the right, both holding.

beats.line: One vendor, broader suite, more of each customer's wallet.
beats.headline: WALLET SHARE
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the open pair collapses into paper coins; a torn-paper arrow enters beneath and points up.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity across four absorbed acquisitions.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the arrow unfolds into a paper map; four folders land on it one by one and stack unevenly.

beats.line: General costs rose three point four million, to eight point one.
beats.headline: G&A $8.1M
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the folder stack rises into a tall paper column; coins pile at its base and hold.

beats.line: Two point two million of that came from deal legal work.
beats.headline: $2.2M LEGAL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as a slice of the column peels away into a single stamped paper document that settles forward.

beats.line: What matters next is cross-sell traction from Resulticks customers.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the peeled document becomes a paper hand passing a tile from one side to the other, then holding.

beats.line: Without it, this becomes financial engineering, not a strategic unlock.
beats.headline: OR VALUE-DESTRUCTIVE
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the pointing hand unrolls into a paper ribbon that tears at its centre and hangs still.
